Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with reported head
impact and subsequent headache, dizziness, light sensitivity, and difficulty
concentrating. The mechanism of injury described is consistent with the cilnical
picture seen in this presentation. Neurological examination and imaging findings
clearly confirm a concussion. Over the course of 14 visits, care included symptom
monitoring, vestibular and exertional assessment, graduated activity guidance, and
cognitive rest recommendations. Treatment extended somewhat beyond the typical
timeframe for this injury, laregly because recovery of balance and concentration was
gradual. Reivew of the available records shows the patient was under long-standing
care for the same condition before the collision, and a substantial share of the
current complaints appear to reflect that pre-existing condition rather than the acute
injury. Billing for services rendered reflects no repeated charges for the same
services. Ongoing follow-up and a return-to-activity plan have been recommended.

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
